title: Crispy Kale Bake
description: A delicious and easy vegan bake recipe that combines crispy kale with a flavorful Mexican-inspired seasoning.

ingredients.name: Kale
ingredients.amount: 2 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves torn into bite-sized pieces

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, massage the kale with your hands for about 2-3 minutes to help break down the fibers and make it more tender.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the glazed Mexican seasoning and bake seasoning.
4. Add the seasoning mixture to the kale and toss to coat evenly.
5. Drizzle the olive oil over the kale and toss again to coat.
6. Spread the kale mixture out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the kale is crispy and golden brown.
8. Remove the kale from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
